mainEntity.name: Do I need permits for wheelchair accessible home modifications in Pacifica or Daly City?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, many wheelchair accessible home modifications, especially those involving structural changes, electrical work, plumbing, or significant alterations to the building's footprint, typically require permits in Pacifica, Daly City, and other Bay Area cities. This ensures that the modifications comply with local building codes and safety regulations. Your contractor will help identify which permits are necessary for your specific project and manage the application process.
